_source: Assistant v2 synonym bank for build-plan row 11a (docs/assistant.md §10.2 A; D-58). Cowork 05.11.2026. Words only, no facts. products: one entry per site/src/data/products.json id — nl (NL + Flemish), ro (RO + Moldovan + products.json alias), typo (no-diacritic and common misspellings; the island also strips diacritics itself). Base forms come from the product names; curated forms are words customers use (lexicon §2–3 word banks, the 27.10 counter list). intents: trigger words NL / RO. A word that fits several products (worst, gehakt, cârnați, spek, pulpe, cotlet …) is resolved by the clarify chips, not here.
